reason: "No pork ingredients" is not the same as halal-certified, and I see no halal logo mentioned, so I am not bringing a brand I have never heard of into my house. I would follow the page, take the free pack, and keep buying Whiskas with the groceries at RM 2 a pouch.
objection: It says no pork, but is it actually halal-certified? There is no JAKIM logo or any certificate mentioned, and it is a new brand nobody here knows. On top of that it is RM 0.80 more per pouch than what my cat already eats happily.
would_change_my_mind: A recognised halal logo (JAKIM or one JAKIM accepts) printed on the pack, and the pouches sold on a supermarket shelf or Shopee at close to RM 2.20 so I do not have to order by Facebook message.
